name: lfs_micro_replication
source: Statistics Canada LFS PUMF (Sibley Creek O-B replication of BoC SAN 2024-23)
source_id: LFS PUMF via annual bundles + monthly; PUMF vintage 2026-05
notes: Oaxaca-Blinder two-fold decomposition of WLS log-wage regression on LFS PUMF monthly cross-sections. Spec: weighted=True, smoothing=raw, ob_reference=base. Calibrated vs BoC Valet INDINF_LFSMICRO_M. UNITS: headline columns are geometric percent, (exp(lp)-1)*100. The BoC publishes INDINF_LFSMICRO_M in log points (100*dlog); convert (exp(lp/100)-1)*100 before comparing, or compare lp-vs-lp (canonical fidelity metric; see calibrate.py). Headline columns are unsmoothed single-month estimates (the BoC series is unsmoothed: matching roughness, no MA signature); _raw_pct columns duplicate them under this spec. interaction_lp/pct: O-B two-fold residual (total_fitted - underlying - composition). raw_mean_pct is weighted mean log-wage growth (geometric mean ratio), not the LFS headline arithmetic average wage growth. Scope: 2016+ replication (release-morning PUMF tool; not a full-history replication of the published paper). Reference: Bounajm/Devakos/Galassi, BoC SAN 2024-23. PUMF vintage: 2026-05.
